gloss: three years; for three years; period of three years

definitions.gloss: three years; period of three years
definitions.explanation: A duration of three years. The suffix {間|かん} emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {三年|さんねん} which can also mean 'third year.'

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}は{三年間|さんねんかん}です。
{三年間|さんねんかん}{留学|りゅうがく}していました。
examples.english: I was studying abroad for three years.

examples.japanese: この{研究|けんきゅう}には{三年間|さんねんかん}の{時間|じかん}と{多|おお}くの{努力|どりょく}がかかった。
examples.english: This research took three years and a great deal of effort.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix {間|かん} to {三年|さんねん}, making it unambiguously mean 'three years long' rather than 'third year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三年間|さんねんかん}{続|つづ}く: to continue for three years
- {三年間|さんねんかん}の{経験|けいけん}: three years of experience
- {三年間|さんねんかん}{勤|つと}める: to work for three years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三年|さんねん}: three years; third year — shorter form, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- {三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year student — ordinal, not duration
